# Golden fixtures — SYNTHETIC, DEVELOPMENT ONLY

The files in this directory are generated by `scripts/generate_golden_fixtures.py`.
They are **synthetic development fixtures**, not business-approved golden
data — no client or regulator has reviewed expected output for them. They
exist to regression-test the pipeline (verification → generation → numeric
guard) whenever prompts, the model, the glossary, or generation logic
change.

Each fixture's signature is tied to the dev keypair that existed in `keys/`
at generation time. If you regenerate the dev keys, regenerate these
fixtures too: `python scripts/generate_golden_fixtures.py`.

Replace this set with real, business/regulator-approved runs and expected
disclosures before relying on it for production regression testing.
